dashboard.label: Admin: Data Mapping
dashboard.description: Sankey view of how raw vendor data maps into the canonical Wearables model
dashboard.definition:
{"title":"Admin: Data Mapping","description":"Sankey view of how raw vendor data maps into the canonical Wearables model (activity taxonomy + ingest lineage).","visualizations":{"intro_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"markdown":"How raw vendor data collapses into the canonical Wearables model — the visual companion to **Ingest & Data Quality**.

- **Activity taxonomy** — each vendor's raw workout label flows into a normalized activity (UPPERCASE middle layer) and then a coarse group (Cardio / Strength / Flexibility). Ribbon width = workout count. Backed by the admin-editable `wearable_activity_map.csv`.
- **Ingest lineage** — which vendors feed which canonical model datasets. Ribbon width = distinct days of coverage (not raw event count, so the heart-rate firehose doesn't swamp it). Two vendors flowing into one dataset = the multi-vendor / Apple-relay overlap.","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)"}},"viz_tax":{"type":"splunk.sankey","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_tax"},"title":"Activity taxonomy — raw label → canonical → group (width = workouts)"},"viz_lineage":{"type":"splunk.sankey","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_lineage"},"title":"Ingest lineage — vendor → canonical model dataset (width = days of coverage)"},"unknown_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"markdown":"**Open-vendor discovery.** Apple/Google relay from an OPEN set of devices — ones without their own API (Hume, RingConn, …) push into Apple Health / Google Health Connect. When a fetcher meets a source it doesn't recognize it stamps a **provisional** vendor from the raw label (the honest origin — the aggregator is only the transport, `sourcetype=apple:*`/`google:*`) and emits a `WARN unknown relayed source`. Rows below are candidates: confirm the device, then add the label to that fetcher's known list (`VENDOR_KEYWORDS` / `PACKAGE_VENDOR`) so it maps to a canonical vendor. **Empty table = every relayed source is recognized.**","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)"}},"viz_unknown":{"type":"splunk.table","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_unknown_src"},"title":"Unrecognized relayed sources — potential new vendors"}},"dataSources":{"ds_tax":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Taxonomy flow","options":{"query":"| datamodel Wearables Workout flat
| stats count as value by workout_activity workout_activity_canon
| eval source=workout_activity, target=upper(workout_activity_canon)
| table source target value
| append
 [| datamodel Wearables Workout flat
 | stats count as value by workout_activity_canon workout_activity_group
 | eval source=upper(workout_activity_canon), target=workout_activity_group
 | table source target value]","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$dm_time.earliest$","latest":"$dm_time.latest$"}}},"ds_lineage":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Ingest lineage","options":{"query":"`widx` NOT sourcetype IN (wearable_registry_backup, wearable_dq_finding)
| eval d=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d")
| eval dataset=mvappend(if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_sleep"),"Sleep",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_heartrate"),"HeartRate",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_activity"),"Activity",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_workout"),"Workout",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_daily"),"Daily",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_device"),"Device",null()), if(searchmatch("tag=wearable_extra"),"Extra (unmapped)",null()))
| eval dataset=if(mvcount(dataset)>0,dataset,"Other")
| mvexpand dataset
| stats dc(d) as value by vendor dataset
| eval source=vendor, target=dataset
| table source target value","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$dm_time.earliest$","latest":"$dm_time.latest$"}}},"ds_unknown_src":{"type":"ds.search","name":"Unrecognized relayed sources","options":{"query":"`wlogidx` sourcetype=wearables:ingest "unknown relayed source"
| stats sum(points) as points, min(_time) as first_seen, max(_time) as last_seen, values(via) as via, values(vendor) as provisional_vendor by raw_source
| eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen,"%Y-%m-%d"), last_seen=strftime(last_seen,"%Y-%m-%d")
| sort - points
| rename raw_source as "raw source (unmapped)", provisional_vendor as "provisional vendor", via as "via aggregator", points as "points seen", first_seen as "first seen", last_seen as "last seen"","queryParameters":{"earliest":"$dm_time.earliest$","latest":"$dm_time.latest$"}}}},"inputs":{"input_dm_trp":{"type":"input.timerange","options":{"token":"dm_time","defaultValue":"-90d@d,now"},"title":"Time Range"}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":1830,"display":"auto","backgroundImage":{"x":0,"y":0,"src":"/static/app/wearables/bg_health.svg","sizeType":"cover"}},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":200}},{"item":"viz_tax","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":240,"w":1400,"h":560}},{"item":"viz_lineage","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":820,"w":1400,"h":480}},{"item":"unknown_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1320,"w":1400,"h":150}},{"item":"viz_unknown","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1490,"w":1400,"h":320}}],"globalInputs":["input_dm_trp"]}}
